Programname: Diploma Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI and ML)
eligibilityindian:
Pass with 50% aggregate marks "For the calculation of aggregate marks, the best five subjects with the highest scores in the qualifying examination will be considered. However, if any specific subject(s) is mandated as part of the eligibility criteria for a particular program at LPU, then the marks obtained in that subject(s) must be included in the aggregate calculation. For further details, please refer to Part-C of the Prospectus." in 10th (with Mathematics, Science and English) or equivalent.

For a candidate, who has not studied English as a subject, the condition of English may be waived off provided the candidate in his qualifying exam has studied in English medium or an equivalent subject.

Note: In case any student has studied Physics instead of Science then also eligible

5% relaxation in aggregate marks in the qualifying examination will be applicable for candidates from North-East states and Sikkim, Defence Personnel, their dependents, and wards of Kashmiri migrants.
internationaleligibilitycomments:
Pass with 50% marks in Grade 10 / O Level or equivalent (with Mathematics and Science) and English Language Requirement (ELR).

indianfeecomments:
• The fee for each successive semester shall be payable before the preceding semester’s teaching period ends.
  • The examination fee is ₹5000 per semester; the 1st-semester examination fee can be paid along with the 2nd-semester fee or earlier.
  • For fees other than the programme fee, please refer to the section ""Fee for Additional Services/Facilities"" in  General Guidelines for Admissions.
  • The term Programme Fee includes tuition and development fees, University fees for registration/enrolment, cultural, sports, club, and co-curricular activities, and fees for additional services such as contingency, outreach, placement, medical support, and counselling, as prescribed by the University.
  • If the programme fee is reduced for any reason, the scholarship amount for all categories will be reduced proportionately. As a result, the final fee payable after the scholarship will remain the same.
  • Please note that no representative of Lovely Professional University would request the transfer of any funds to a personal account or engage in personal chats with aspirants or their guardians. In case of any such activity, you should report the incident immediately to info@lpu.co.in.
  • For aggregate marks in the qualifying examination, refer to the clause “Eligibility” under General Guidelines for Admissions.
  • Students applying for any scholarship, grant, loan, or financial assistance provided by a government, semi-government body, public undertaking, NGO, private agency, or any other organisation must pay the applicable programme fee, examination fee, and charges for residential and other facilities as per the University’s payment timelines for each semester until completion of the programme. The University will not communicate with or intervene on behalf of students with such agencies, nor will it submit or upload any documents related to these schemes. However, the University may provide the required documents to students in accordance with University norms.
modeofpayment:
• Demand Draft/Pay Order in favour of "LOVELY FACULTY OF TECHNOLOGY AND SCIENCES" payable at JALANDHAR
  • Cash can be deposited only at the Division of Admissions, University Campus, Phagwara (Punjab)
  • Credit Card/Debit Card (only for online submission of the application)
Requisites:
Requisites/ Conditions
  • Procuring atleast one textbook for each course and carry bag in all semesters/ years and Laptop is compulsory.
  • Students will be required spend approximately Rs.4000 for University Uniform at the time of admission. It would include 1 Navy blue blazer with logo, 1 Navy blue trousers, 2 White shirts, 1 Tie, 1 Tracksuit with logo and 1 T-shirt with logo as per the requirement of the respective programme.
  • The expense of uniform (if any) will be borne by the applicant himself/ herself admitted under any other such scholarship scheme like Other Agencies or NGO Scholarships.
Highlights
